title: AI-Enabled Soil Analysis and Weather Station for Local Farmers
summary: The CSIR-INSTI team built a TinyML weather-monitoring prototype for a proposed farm-advisory system and later field-tested a soil sensor in Ghana; no gain for farmers is reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: In June 2025 the CSIR-INSTI team described a TinyML weather-monitoring prototype that supports a proposed farm-advisory system for local farmers. The team said that it planned further development beyond the experimental phase. It did not report any effect on yield, income or resource use. The team later ran a 15-week field trial of a low-cost soil sensor at Sumbrungu Experimental Farm in Bolgatanga, Ghana, from 14 March to 26 June 2026, under the LSACROFT project. It published the trial data on 22 September 2026. The release reports sensor and crop measurements and no gain for farmers.
purpose: Give farmers localized environmental information for cultivation decisions.
system: AI soil-analysis and local weather-station system
developer: CSIR-Institute for Scientific and Technological Information (CSIR-INSTI)
